body.x: Pioncorporation (CEO Bomjin Jong) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.
As an AI-based advertising content producer founded in 2019, Pioncorporation launched VCAT.

VCAT.AI is a marketing automation tool that produces an advertising video in one minute. With a product URL entered, the AI solution automatically creates a marketing video with the ability to generate hundreds of types of banners in one sitting. Even just 30 seconds of footage recorded on a smartphone can be utilized to create videos for various channels such as Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

“Although there are many automation solutions available in the digital advertising market, advertising videos still take a long time to make. And so, we thought the developing technology of deep learning could automate the creation of image materials and started to build VCAT.AI,” a representative from Pioncorporation explained their development background.

With the motto of “Make the easiest and fastest image materials in the world,” VCAT.AI was launched in beta this year. Since then, the solution has been growing rapidly, from reaping KRW 1 million of sales in January to surpassing KRW 100 million in November. About 500 subscribers, including large portal businesses, open markets, and cosmetics businesses and distributors in South Korea, are known to pay for the service.

According to the representative, “We plan to implement VCAT.AI to cover automatic generation of ad footage and images through automatic running of ads on social channels in 2023. Machine learning will be employed to give more exposure to materials with good advertising efficiency. Also, materials that have been showing poor advertising efficiency will be replaced with others. This entire process will be automated.” "And we are eager to reach overseas markets as well. By participating in the CES, our service will be introduced to the U.S. market in earnest,” said the representative describing their future plans.

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
* Special Report Team : Joseph Choe, Kidai Kim, Dongkwan Kim, Mokkyung Lee, Sangun Choi, Joon Suh Lee, Yeawon Choi, Jinnsun Park, Seung Hyun Nam, Min Seok Cha
